visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair and large black sunglasses smiles brightly while holding up a peace sign on a boat. She wears a pink and white varsity jacket. The background features Sun Moon Lake under a bright, clear sky. (2) The scene shifts to a luxury hotel lobby with gold lattice walls and a large, iconic yellow and black polka-dot pumpkin sculpture. A staff member in a uniform walks past a floral arrangement. (3) View from a high balcony overlooking the lake at dusk; clouds are scattered across the sky. The camera pans across the interior of a luxury hotel suite with floor-to-ceiling windows showing a panoramic lake view. (4) An aerial or high-angle shot shows the surrounding buildings like Hanbi Lou and Teacher's Hostel tucked into the green hillside by the water. (5) On a rooftop, the woman sits on a lounge chair by an infinity pool that merges with the lake view. A hand holds a bottle of Aesop protective body lotion against the backdrop of the water. (6) A sequence of interior shots shows a high-end sauna with wooden slats and a bath area facing the lake. (7) Close-ups of a tea salon menu and various food items: fresh pastries, a seafood buffet with sashimi, scallops, and abalone. (8) Plated gourmet dishes are served on white tablecloths, including an omelet with a lobster claw and a small bowl of orange porridge. (9) A baby with a bottle lies on a towel, laughing. Amenities like green and brown leather pouches with skincare tubes are shown. (10) Back on the luxury boat, a spread of tropical fruits like passion fruit, oranges, and bananas is laid out. Iced beverages and thermoses are available. The woman gestures again as the sun sets over the hotel building on the hill.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 日月潭三天兩夜 8萬塊. (2) [Subtitle]: 到底是把我當盤子 還是真有其價值呢!? (3) [Subtitle]: 漢來日月行館 是最近 討論度很高的飯店. (4) [Subtitle]: 不得不說 一進門就很震撼 真的是非常奢華. (5) [Subtitle]: 一整面的湖景超級美 房間的景色一等一 可以看到很漂亮的湖景. (6) [Subtitle]: 但往下看 就會看到涵碧樓 跟隔壁的教師會館. [Variety]: 美中不足的台灣美學. (7) [Subtitle]: 最漂亮的是頂樓的泳池 可以俯瞰日月潭. (8) [Subtitle]: 服務人員還會送上防曬乳 好享受. [Variety]: 高級防曬乳推推. (9) [Subtitle]: 三溫暖也很值得去 看著湖景泡湯 真的是有一種人上人的感覺. (10) [Subtitle]: 8萬塊是有含四餐的 兩份早餐兩份晚餐 不得不說都很美味. (11) [Subtitle]: 但是晚餐單價 一人份其實 是要4,000元!! [Variety]: 一人份其實 是要4,000元!!. (12) [Subtitle]: 我是覺得有點太貴了. (13) [Subtitle]: 但食物都精緻又好吃 早餐晚餐都有buffet. (14) [Subtitle]: 下午的茶屋 跟晚上的宵夜 也是免費提供!! 說實在吃的很開心. (15) [Subtitle]: 住房有送過夜包 行程包含的遊湖 也是非常的奢華. (16) [Subtitle]: 可以一邊喝飲料吃水果 一邊遊日月潭. (17) [Subtitle]: 大體而言我覺得是有 做出市場區隔!! 但是真的太貴了. (18) [Subtitle]: 或是乾脆出國呢?? 你會來嗎.
